name: routes-a-cross-cutting-request-to-the-right-boundaries
description: A request that is genuinely two requests: something for one service now, and something the platform should arguably do for everyone. The interesting behaviour is not which files come out — it is that the split is made explicitly and each half lands on the right side of the ownership boundary, rather than the platform-wide half being quietly implemented inside one team's deployment state where it helps nobody else.
intent: checkout-platform-auth needs an alert when it gets OOMKilled. Honestly every service probably wants that, but start with ours.

fixture.note: The service-scoped half done correctly. The alert ships with the service, as values in that service's own deployment state, which the application's shared chart renders into a PrometheusRule. Nothing shared by the application's other services is touched, so nothing here is flagged — the consolidated chart made the divergence this case used to warn about impossible to express. The platform-wide half is raised as an open question rather than implemented inside one team's repository.

changeSets.summary: Added an OOMKill alert to checkout-platform-auth's dev deployment state. It fires on a container termination reason rather than on a memory-usage threshold, so it reports what actually happened instead of predicting it. Left every other service alone: the same rule for everyone is a platform change, and it is raised as an open question below rather than made here.
openQuestions: Should this become a cluster-wide rule in platform-demo-gitops, keyed by label so it reaches every service? That is a platform-team call, and doing it centrally is the only version that reaches teams who never thought to ask for it.

files.contents:
# Desired state for one service in one environment.
serviceName: auth
environment: dev

nameOverride: checkout-platform-auth

image:
  repository: 382334305409.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/checkout-platform-auth
  tag: "9f2c1ab"
  digest: "sha256:1f5a0c3c7e2b4d6a8f9012345678901234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12"

istio:
  gatewayHost: "checkout-platform-auth.dev.platform-demo.acme.io"

provisionS3Bucket: false

resources:
  requests: { cpu: 50m, memory: 64Mi }
  limits: { memory: 128Mi }

prometheusRules:
  - alert: CheckoutPlatformAuthOOMKilled
    expr: |
      increase(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled",container="checkout-platform-auth"}[10m]) > 0
    for: 0m
    labels:
      severity: warning
      team: checkout-team
    annotations:
      summary: "checkout-platform-auth was OOMKilled"
      description: "A container was killed for exceeding its memory limit in the last 10 minutes. Either the limit is too low for current traffic or something is leaking."
files.rationale: Adds the OOMKill alert as this service's own deployment state, leaving the shared chart and every sibling service untouched.
